verdict.line: You lose if you trade near walls where her tentacles pile up; you win if you force fights in open lane and respect her E timer.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's threat is entirely tied to terrain — her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain, and those Tentacles both hit you and heal her when she lands W (Harsh Lesson) or E (Test of Spirit) near them. Away from walls she has no extra damage source and Aatrox's dash-and-heal kit trades clean into her. The 46.7% win rate over 1074 games reflects a lane that is genuinely even once you control where the fight happens.

theirWindow.when: you're tethered by her E near walls
theirWindow.what: Do not trade while a spirit is out — damage you deal gets echoed back onto you, and nearby Tentacles swing at you too. Walk the spirit away from terrain or just disengage until it expires.

yourWindow.when: her E is down, you're off terrain
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window. Go in with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and use E (Umbral Dash) to stick and heal — her only answer is W (Harsh Lesson), a single-target leap on a 4s cooldown that can't out-damage your sustain here.

start.why: Run with the 49.9% win rate pick (1018 games) — the extra sustain and AD let you match her early poke without a wall to fish off.

boots.why: Her W and Tentacle autos are all physical; Plated Steelcaps (50.2% WR, 76.9% pick) blunts the chip damage you take walking into range.

core.why: The shield plus the proc damage wins the short trade windows between her E cooldowns.
Highest-rated path (63.8% WR, 69 games) with Eclipse — the on-hit heal stacks with your E passive sustain.
Converts the burst she gets off Tentacle procs into damage over time you can heal through.

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades near her Tentacles reward stacking Conqueror — it's the only keystone in the live data and it rewards the sustained-fight pattern this lane turns into.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 84.6% of games at a 49.3% win rate — Ignite's healing cut matters directly against her Tentacle sustain, per OP.GG's own tip to carry anti-heal into this lane.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Illaoi's passive only spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Pull trades into open sections of the lane where she has no extra damage or healing source.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s. If you're tethered by a spirit, stop trading — damage you take gets echoed back onto you and nearby Tentacles pile on.

playing.title: Dash in with E, not W, to open
playing.detail: Umbral Dash heals you on champion damage and is up again in 9/8/7/6/5s — use it to close distance and sustain through her autos.

playing.title: Save W for her W commitment
playing.detail: Her Harsh Lesson is a single-target leap on a 4s cooldown — once she's committed into range, land Infernal Chains to drag her back in and stack Q swings.

playing.title: All-in with R away from terrain
playing.detail: World Ender comes online at level 6 (120/100/80/80/80s). Force the fight in the open lane where her kit has no Tentacle backup.

playing.title: Respect her R near walls late
playing.detail: Leap of Faith spawns a Tentacle for every champion it hits — never group for a fight next to terrain once she has it up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the measured win rates above are pulled from current-patch OP.GG data; the terrain-and-cooldown reasoning behind each call is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Illaoi’s (E) while facing her. Purchase items that reduce healing and maintain some distance to use your abilities to when fighting her.
